ex.en: No one knew what awaited us.
ex.zh: 沒有人知道等著我們的是什麼。

ex.en: I await updates.
ex.zh: 我在等候最新消息。

ex.en: We are awaiting your reply.
ex.zh: 我們正在等候您的回覆。

ex.en: We shall all miss you when you go away.
ex.zh: 你走了以後，我們都會想你。

ex.en: You had better get away from here at once.
ex.zh: 你最好馬上離開這裡。

ex.en: When the cat is away, the mice will play.
ex.zh: 貓不在，老鼠就作怪。

ex.en: My manager is away this week.
ex.zh: 我主管這週不在。

ex.en: The town is two miles away from the coast.
ex.zh: 那個小鎮離海岸兩英里。

ex.en: The station is ten minutes away.
ex.zh: 車站離這裡十分鐘。

ex.en: I'll do it right away.
ex.zh: 我馬上去做。

ex.en: Please call me back right away.
ex.zh: 請馬上回電給我。

ex.en: I'm sorry to hear that your father passed away.
ex.zh: 聽到你父親過世，我很難過。

ex.en: His grandfather passed away last year.
ex.zh: 他祖父去年過世了。

ex.en: He was not aware of the danger.
ex.zh: 他沒有意識到自己有危險。

ex.en: I wasn't aware that Tom was sleeping.
ex.zh: 我不知道湯姆在睡覺。

ex.en: I became aware of someone looking at me.
ex.zh: 我察覺到有人在看我。

ex.en: In addition, we will issue the 'employee of the month' award afterwards.
ex.zh: 另外，之後我們會頒發「每月最佳員工」獎。

ex.en: She won an award for her design.
ex.zh: 她的設計得了獎。

ex.en: They awarded her first prize at the art exhibition.
ex.zh: 他們在畫展上頒給她首獎。

ex.en: He was awarded a grant to study in Germany.
ex.zh: 他獲得一筆到德國留學的獎學金。

ex.en: He's been awarded a gold medal once.
ex.zh: 他曾經獲頒金牌。

ex.en: I don't recommend eating in that restaurant. The food is awful.
ex.zh: 我不推薦那家餐廳，東西很難吃。

ex.en: I made an awful mistake in the test.
ex.zh: 我考試時犯了一個很嚴重的錯誤。

ex.en: I know I did an awful thing.
ex.zh: 我知道我做了很糟糕的事。

ex.en: What an awful lot of books you have!
ex.zh: 你的書也太多了吧！

ex.en: It took an awful lot of time to finish the report.
ex.zh: 完成這份報告花了非常多時間。

ex.en: It takes time to develop political awareness.
ex.zh: 培養政治意識要花費時間。

ex.en: April 2nd is World Autism Awareness Day.
ex.zh: 4 月 2 日是世界自閉症關懷日。

ex.en: The campaign aims to raise awareness of climate change.
ex.zh: 這項活動旨在提高大眾對氣候變遷的認識。

ex.en: Po-lin ran into his ex at the night market yesterday. It was super awkward.
ex.zh: 柏霖昨天在夜市遇到前女友，尷尬到不行。

ex.en: There was an awkward silence after he asked the question.
ex.zh: 他問完那個問題後，現場一陣尷尬的沉默。

ex.en: He is awkward in his movements.
ex.zh: 他笨手笨腳的。

ex.en: The girl made an awkward bow.
ex.zh: 那個女孩笨拙地鞠了個躬。

ex.en: He awkwardly tried to hide the gift behind his back.
ex.zh: 他笨手笨腳地想把禮物藏在背後。

ex.en: They stood awkwardly in the doorway, not knowing what to say.
ex.zh: 他們尷尬地站在門口，不知道該說什麼。
